items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: I didn't know him. I went and looked at him unless I seen him so long.

ctx.x: Oh, Joe Morris, well I didn't know him. I went and looked at him unless I seen him so long. He was right down low pace. Oh yes.
I didn't know him, no. Once we, I know Slowdrag bought his bass in 1945. Yeah, well they say he gave up music. He gave up music.

They tell me he used to play with Sam, Sam Morgan and Chris Kelly. Might have been, I don't know who he was. I don't know, but I told all the people. I went and looked at him. You didn't know him? No, my wife said go and see the father. I said, I'll say no.
